harness_auth.measured: Qoder CLI 1.1.92 (Linux, 2026-11-20): strings of the installed binary names QODER_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN, QODER_PAT, QODER_SDK_ACCESS_TOKEN, QODER_DEVICE_TOKEN and QODER_AUTH_STDIN; none was exercised, and a token-authenticated turn is not measured (docs/evidence/adapters/qoder-cli-1-1.md, Auth and Not measured)

carriage.measured: Q14 (cold) and Q15 (replacement, Q14's argv again), Qoder CLI 1.1.92, Linux, 2026-11-20: under --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config <engine file> --setting-sources "" the engine sentinel started, init listed it connected, and it answered tools/call under an --allowed-tools grant naming it mcp__<server>__<tool> (docs/evidence/adapters/qoder-cli-1-1.md, MCP isolation (SI2))

ambient.measured: Q01 and Q02, the positive control: with no MCP flags the user, local, project and plugin sentinels all started; Q07 and Q10 (cold): under --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config <empty file> --setting-sources "" no planted sentinel started and init mcp_servers was [] (docs/evidence/adapters/qoder-cli-1-1.md, MCP isolation (SI2))

on.unsupported: level 1 never offers a web tool (#1178, decision 0075): brokkr driver qoder always passes --tools Read Edit Write Glob Grep Bash, and no argv of the driver lists WebFetch

off.default: brokkr driver qoder always passes --tools Read Edit Write Glob Grep Bash, and the record measured that --tools with names restricts the built-ins to those names; with no --tools, init lists 34 tools under accept_edits, WebFetch and WebSearch among them (docs/evidence/adapters/qoder-cli-1-1.md, Tools)

restrictions.unsupported: no native transport for a restriction on Qoder CLI's WebFetch has been established

evidence.scope: the tools init lists under the driver's fixed --tools list; no live call of WebFetch, with or without the list, was tried
limitations: that the fixed --tools list leaves WebFetch out is init's list, not a refused live call

ambient MCP isolation is measured without hands on Linux only (docs/evidence/adapters/qoder-cli-1-1.md, MCP isolation (SI2)); a managed or enterprise MCP configuration was not measured, so a server it loads may still reach the web
